tagline.en: Kling's interactive, streaming video generator for real-time video synthesis.
tagline.zh: Kling 推出的交互式流式视频生成器,面向实时视频合成。

en: ShotStream is an interactive video generation model from the Kling team (Kling AI Research). It is built for streaming, real-time video synthesis rather than one-shot offline rendering, so frames are produced as an ongoing stream you can interact with.
In WorldFoundry the official inference route is registered. You stage the ShotStream checkpoint and streaming assets, then run generation through the pipeline to produce interactive, streaming video.
zh: ShotStream 是 Kling 团队(Kling AI Research)推出的交互式视频生成模型。它面向流式、实时的视频合成,而非一次性的离线渲染,因此画面以持续的流形式产生,可供交互。
在 WorldFoundry 中已注册官方推理路由。备好 ShotStream 的 checkpoint 与流式资源后,即可通过 pipeline 运行生成,产出交互式的流式视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want interactive, real-time streaming video generation rather than a single pre-rendered clip.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要交互式、实时的流式视频生成,而非单段预渲染片段时。

notFor.en: Running it requires downloading the checkpoint and streaming assets first. Check the model's licensing terms before use.
notFor.zh: 运行前需先下载 checkpoint 与流式资源。使用前请确认该模型的许可条款。
